description: Na₃H₅As₄O₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.97 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to six O atoms to form AsO₆ octahedra that share corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one AsO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.94 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to six O atoms to form AsO₆ octahedra that share corners with two AsO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one AsO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.95 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-64°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.76 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 60°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.78 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.01 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.08 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) H-O bond length. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one As, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two As atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two As atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one As, and one H atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two As and one H atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two As and one H atom.
